zoning.district_source: Murray PC minutes 2023-04-06 p.4: 'It is located in the R-1-6 zone' (final approval); condition 6 cites Chapter 17.96 (Single-Family Medium Density Residential District R-1-6). Rezone R-1-8 -> R-1-6 recommended by PC 2021-10-21 and effective before preliminary approval 2022-11-17.
zoning.min_frontage_source: Murray PC minutes 2022-11-17 condition 11 (https://www.murray.utah.gov/Archive/ViewFile/Item/7396, accessed 2026-09-24): 'amend lot 7 to meet the lot width requirement of sixty feet (60') at the twenty-foot (20') setback line'; 2023-04-06 minutes p.4: 'the lot frontage on Lot 7 was originally not wide enough. It now meets the requirements of the zone.' 60-ft lot width used as frontage proxy per policy (no separate frontage minimum stated in the approval record; verified absence in code text unconfirmed -- see gap).
zoning.min_lot_area_source: Murray PC minutes 2023-04-06 p.4 (https://www.utah.gov/pmn/files/991087.pdf, accessed 2026-09-24): 'It is located in the R-1-6 zone, which requires a minimum of 6,000 square feet per lot.' (staff presentation of final plat; official city record, source-precedence 3)
zoning.road_width_source: Murray Code Sec. 16.16.180 (https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/murrayut/latest/murray_ut/0-0-0-9269, accessed 2026-09-24): all streets minimum 49-ft width (25-ft asphalted). Tripp Lane extension conditioned to the 49-ft city standard (PC minutes 2022-11-17 condition 10; confirmed corrected to 49 ft in 2023-04-06 minutes p.4). 49-ft ROW used as the pipeline street corridor.
zoning.source: Murray PC minutes 2022-11-17 (preliminary 5-1; https://www.murray.utah.gov/Archive/ViewFile/Item/7396) and 2023-04-06 (final 6-0; https://www.utah.gov/pmn/files/991087.pdf), both accessed 2026-09-24; Murray Code Sec. 16.16.180 (https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/murrayut/latest/murray_ut/0-0-0-9269, accessed 2026-09-24). Per-dimension citations in min_lot_area_source / min_frontage_source / road_width_source.
zoning.source_gap: R-1-6 code text (Chapter 17.96) not directly retrievable 2026-09-24 (amlegal API Cloudflare-blocked; chapter page links not extractable). Dimensional values come from the approving body's official minutes (source-precedence 3), which state them explicitly.

rulegraph.note: 'clean' reflects geometric validation only. RuleGraph verdicts are reported separately with a per-scheme applicable-rule count ('rulegraph_applicable_rules'). A scheme is compliance-confirmed only when its rulegraph verdict is PASS with at least one applicable verified rule. A PASS with zero applicable rules means no verified rule in the store covered the parcel's district — that is 'no applicable verified rules', not a compliance finding.

use_allowance.note: Use-allowance verdicts are machine-evaluated against the human-verified §21A.33 use-table packs: 191 M-1/OS/PL rows (human verdicts by Rohan, 2026-09-23) + 322 MU-5/MU-6/MU-11 rows (batch-verified by Rohan, 2026-09-23; the machine evaluates, never verifies). UNKNOWN never means allowed — it means the use could not be confirmed (no proposed uses supplied, no use rows for the district, no matching verified row, or an ambiguous row such as M1-U-28). MANUAL_REVIEW means a qualifying-provision footnote whose text was not retrieved needs a human read. FAIL rows are blank-cell code facts (the §21A.33 legend: blank = not permitted).
